sub_tasks.requirements: Iterative label mapping is implemented, following Chen et al. (2023)
The frequency distribution of the dataset of the new task can be computed, following Algorithm 2

When computing the frequency distribution of the dataset, a matrix $d$ is initialized with zeros; $d \leftarrow \{0\}^{|\mathcal{Y}^P| \times |\mathcal{Y}^T|}$, where $\mathcal{Y}^T$ are the labels of the target task, and $\mathcal{Y}^P$ are the labels of the pre-trained task

verification.spec: Call the frequency-computation function and inspect the initialized frequency matrix `d`. Assert that its shape equals (|Y^P|, |Y^T|) (e.g., (1000, 10) for ImageNet→CIFAR10) and that all initial entries are 0 before accumulation.

sub_tasks.requirements: When computing the frequency distribution of the dataset, given a target training set $\{(x_i^T,y_i^T)\}_{i=1}^n$, for each sample in the training set, the output label is computed as $\hat{y}_i^P \leftarrow f_P\left(f_\text{in}\left(x_i^\top \vert \theta \right)\right)$, where $f_P$ is the pre-trained model, and $f_{\text{in}}(\cdot | \theta)$ is the visual reprogramming model

verification.spec: Mock a pre-trained model f_P and f_in, call the frequency-computation function with a small target training set, and verify that predictions ŷ_i^P are obtained by passing f_in(x_i^T | θ) through f_P for each sample (via a spy/mock on f_P confirming call args match f_in output).

sub_tasks.requirements: When computing the frequency distribution of the dataset, for each predicted label $\hat{y}_i^P$, the frequency distribution matrix is updated; $d_{\hat{y}_i^P, y_i^T} \leftarrow d_{\hat{y}_i^P, y_i^T} + 1$

verification.spec: Construct a small labeled dataset with known predictions ŷ_i^P and target y_i^T, run the frequency-computation function, and verify that the returned d matrix has d[ŷ_i^P, y_i^T] entries incremented exactly by the number of matching (prediction, target) pairs.

sub_tasks.requirements: The output mapping can be computed, following Algorithm 4
When computing the output mapping using Iterative label mapping, at the start of each epoch the frequency distribution of the target training set is first computed

verification.spec: Instrument the training loop to record when the frequency distribution `d` is computed. Run 2 epochs and verify the frequency function is invoked at the start of each epoch (before mini-batch loss updates for that epoch).

sub_tasks.requirements: When computing the output mapping using Iterative label mapping, on each epoch the following algorithm is applied; $\mathcal{Y}_\text{sub}^P$ is initialized as $\emptyset$. Until the size of $\mathcal{Y}_\text{sub}^P$ is $|\mathcal{Y}^T|$ the following steps are taken: 1) the maximum $d_{y^P, y^T}$ in frequency distribution $d$ is found and added to $\mathcal{Y}_\text{sub}^P$, 2) the label mapping is updated as $f_\text{out}^\text{Ilm} (y^P) \leftarrow y^T$, 3) the frequency distribution is updated as $d_{y^P, t} \leftarrow 0 \text{ for } t=1,2,...,|\mathcal{Y}^T|$, and $d_{s, y^T} \leftarrow 0 \text{ for } s=1,2,...,|\mathcal{Y}^P|$

verification.spec: Construct a small synthetic frequency matrix `d` with known argmax entries. Run the ILM mapping algorithm and verify: (1) Y_sub^P starts empty, (2) it iteratively picks argmax(d) and adds the y^P to Y_sub^P mapped to y^T, (3) once a y^P or y^T is used it is excluded from future iterations, and (4) the final |Y_sub^P| == |Y^T|.
